Exact integer Morse boundary projections are identically zero; low homotopy groups of the respective skeleton wedges make every attaching map null. Mod-two boundary ranks independently corroborate integral Morse conclusions without substituting for them.

value.rationale: Frucht is the canonical small asymmetric cubic graph. The two adjacent scale intervals give complete mixed-dimensional integral homotopy types, contrasting with known Rips and independence results and providing a reproducible, nontrivial graph-Čech benchmark beyond the small-girth recovery range. This is a natural exact graph invariant and does not rely on a claimed broader downstream theorem.
